commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "STEP 1: capture existing content checksums"
find /srv/inventory -type f -exec sha256sum {} \; | sort

echo "STEP 2: create group inventory-readers if missing"
sudo -n getent group inventory-readers >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo -n groupadd inventory-readers
getent group inventory-readers

echo "STEP 3: create system user inventorysvc if missing"
sudo -n getent passwd inventorysvc >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo -n useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /sbin/nologin -g inventorysvc inventorysvc 2>/dev/null || sudo -n useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /sbin/nologin inventorysvc
getent passwd inventorysvc

echo "STEP 4: add inventorysvc to inventory-readers group as well (harmless, not required for owner)"
sudo -n usermod -aG inventory-readers inventorysvc

echo "STEP 5: set ownership recursively to inventorysvc:inventory-readers"
sudo -n chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers /srv/inventory

echo "STEP 6: set permissions - dirs rwxr-x---, files rw-r-----"
sudo -n find /srv/inventory -type d -exec chmod 750 {} \;
sudo -n find /srv/inventory -type f -exec chmod 640 {} \;

echo "STEP 7: verification"
find /srv/inventory -exec ls -ld {} \;
echo "--- content checksums after ---"
find /srv/inventory -type f -exec sha256sum {} \; | sort
